title: Roots of Route 66, The Green Book & The Mother Road
seo_title: Roots of Route 66, The Green Book & The Mother Road
description: This is a presentation by author Candacy Taylor titled Roots of Route 66, The Green Book & The Mother Road, presented by the Lebanon-Laclede County Route 66 Society and The State Historical Society of Missouri. It takes place on Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 6:00 PM at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, Missouri.
